messages.author: 7cc1ece2858b8d25
messages.subject: imageRename doesn´t copy images into outDir
parts:
Hello,
can you please help me with this problem, using camtrapR on my current project?
When renaming the images for further use in camtrapR, "imageRename" creates the file "renaming.table" with the the renamed JPGs but shows "FALSE" in the column "CopyStatus" resulting in the creation of only empty folders in the outDir, where the renamed copies of the JPGs should be. As you can see in the code i´ve provided, down below, "copyImages" is set to "TRUE", so it should normally work as intended but unfortunatelly doesn´t.

Thanks in advance for your response.

> library(camtrapR) This is camtrapR 2.3.0 (CURRENT) > Sys.which("exiftool") exiftool "C:\\PROGRA~1\\RStudio\\RESOUR~1\\app\\bin\\quarto\\bin\\exiftool.exe" > setwd("C:/Users/thesn/OneDrive/Dokumente/Studium/M.Sc. messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] imageRename doesn´t copy images into outDir
parts:
Hello,
Check the length of the output file paths with nchar(). They must be 255 or less characters long. Yours may be more, which would result in the images not copying. 
If that's not the case please share the output of warnings()
Best regards,
Jürgen

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] imageRename doesn´t copy images into outDir
parts:
Update: it was caused by the umlaut Ö in the path names. There is now a check with a warning im imageRename for äöü in the path names (in the dev version on GitHub).
In general, all special characters in path names should be avoided.
